sources.fullCitation: Photographer unidentified. “Alfred Piccaver.” Bain News Service, publisher, between approximately 1920 and 1925. Glass negative, 5 × 7 in. or smaller. Library of Congress, George Grantham Bain Collection, LC-B2-5730-5, digital ID ggbain.34250. Digital reproduction via Wikimedia Commons, File:Alfred Piccaver 02.jpg.
sources.title: Alfred Piccaver — portrait
sources.creator: Photographer unidentified
sources.repository: Library of Congress, George Grantham Bain Collection
sources.researchNote: The Commons reproduction explicitly identifies its source as Library of Congress digital ID ggbain.34250 but leaves the date unknown. The Library’s own Flickr record for the same identifier dates the negative “[between ca. 1920 and ca. 1925]”. That approximate range is used here; it is not a confirmed date of 1920. The publisher is Bain News Service; the photographer remains unidentified.

media.title: Alfred Piccaver — portrait, Bain News Service
media.altText: Black-and-white portrait photograph of the tenor Alfred Piccaver.
media.publicCaption: Alfred Piccaver, the English-born tenor of the Vienna State Opera, who took the lead in Abenteuer am Lido (1933), the Austrian musical comedy scored by Kaper and Jurmann.
media.publicCreditLine: Photographer unidentified, Bain News Service; Library of Congress, George Grantham Bain Collection, ggbain.34250.
media.rightsNote: Public domain in the United States under the PD-US tag on the Wikimedia Commons file. The photograph comes from the Library of Congress George Grantham Bain Collection, for which the Library records no known restrictions on publication. The photographer and exact photography date are unidentified. Commons leaves the date unknown, while the Library’s own record for ggbain.34250 gives an approximate range between 1920 and 1925.
